caption: The drawing depicts a single andiron (a fireplace support), rendered entirely in shades of gray pencil or charcoal on a plain, off-white background. The andiron features a tall, turned baluster-shaped upright post with a rounded, finial-like top and additional ring-like details along its shaft. The post is anchored to a broad, decorative horizontal base with two ornate, scroll-form legs in front, each ending in flat feet. There is a horizontal support bar extending perpendicularly backward from the upright post, shown in a simple angular form, suggesting its functional use to hold logs above the hearth. The overall composition centers the andiron on the page, with its shadowing and contouring emphasized through smooth and blended gradient shading to create a realistic three-dimensional effect. There are no additional objects or elements within the drawing, and the background remains unembellished.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
